data/dnhdd/tables.csv.final: On table rows, electors on the final roll in an area, as a count, and it is blank in every row of this file.
data/dnhdd/tables.csv.men: Men on the roll a table row is split by sex, as a count, and it is blank in every row of this file.
data/dnhdd/tables.csv.women: Women on the roll a table row is split by sex, as a count, and it is blank in every row of this file.
data/dnhdd/tables.csv.third: Third-gender electors on the roll a table row is split by sex, as a count, and it is blank in every row of this file.

data/gujarat/districts.csv.before: Electors on the roll with respect to 1 October 2025, before the revision.
data/gujarat/districts.csv.removed: Names left off the draft roll of 19 December 2025, as a count.

data/haryana/tables.csv.table: Which part of the file the row belongs to, where state marks one of Haryana's headline figures and every other value names a published table, here districts_provisional (Forms not collected in five districts on 15 July 2026, provisional, before the draft, in thousands).

data/haryana/tables.csv.draft: On table rows, electors on the draft roll in an area, as a count, and it is blank in every row of this file.

data/haryana/tables.csv.added: On table rows, names added after the draft in an area, as a count, and it is blank in every row of this file.
data/haryana/tables.csv.net: On table rows, the net change after the draft in an area, which counts new voters as well as names put back, as a count, and it is blank in every row of this file.
data/haryana/tables.csv.final: On table rows, electors on the final roll in an area, as a count, and it is blank in every row of this file.

data/haryana/tables.csv.shifted_absent_other: On left-off table rows, names left off entered as shifted, absent or under any other reason, as a count, and it is blank in every row of this file.
data/haryana/tables.csv.duplicate: On left-off table rows, names left off entered as enrolled more than once, as a count, and it is blank in every row of this file.
data/haryana/tables.csv.source: The title of the document the figure or table comes from.
data/haryana/tables.csv.press: yes where the figure or table reached the site through a newspaper or broadcaster, and no where it was read in an official document.
data/haryana/tables.csv.partial: On table rows, yes where the table covers only some areas and is checked row by row, and no where it is complete and adds up to the state figure, and blank on state rows.

data/hyderabad/constituencies.csv.constituency: One of the five Old City assembly constituencies of Hyderabad for which the elector-by-elector lists were compiled.
data/hyderabad/constituencies.csv.electors: Electors on the roll the revision started from, counted from the lists behind the part explorer. In Charminar, Yakutpura and Bahadurpura it equals the Chief Electoral Officer's pre-revision total exactly, and in Chandrayangutta to within one. Malakpet's export is a different count. The Commission's order of 14 May 2026 does not give the date of that roll.
data/hyderabad/constituencies.csv.struck_off: Names on the September 2026 list of absent, shifted and dead electors, struck off the draft roll, as a count.
data/hyderabad/constituencies.csv.pct_struck_off: Names struck off per 100 electors on the roll before the revision.
data/hyderabad/constituencies.csv.summoned_to_hearing: Electors kept on the draft roll but called to a hearing from the no-mapping list or the logical discrepancy list, each elector counted once, as a count.
data/hyderabad/constituencies.csv.pct_summoned: Electors called to a hearing per 100 electors on the roll before the revision.
data/hyderabad/constituencies.csv.permanently_shifted: Names struck off with the reason permanently shifted, as a count, where the reason is what the officer wrote down, and nobody checked it.
data/hyderabad/constituencies.csv.untraceable_absent: Names struck off with the reason untraceable or absent, as a count.
data/hyderabad/constituencies.csv.death: Names struck off with the reason death, as a count.
data/hyderabad/constituencies.csv.already_enrolled: Names struck off with the reason already enrolled somewhere else, as a count.
data/hyderabad/constituencies.csv.women_pct_struck_off: Women struck off per 100 women on the roll before the revision.
data/hyderabad/constituencies.csv.men_pct_struck_off: Men struck off per 100 men on the roll before the revision.
data/hyderabad/constituencies.csv.margin_2023: The winning margin in votes at the 2023 Telangana assembly election.

data/hyderabad/parts.csv.ac: The Old City assembly constituency the polling part belongs to.
data/hyderabad/parts.csv.part: The polling part number, except in Malakpet, whose export carries no part numbers, where it is a serial for each of its 60 polling stations.
data/hyderabad/parts.csv.locality: The locality or polling-station name the lists give for the part.
data/hyderabad/parts.csv.electors: Electors in the part on the roll the revision started from, counted from the lists (parts with fewer than 100 electors are left out of the file). The Commission's order of 14 May 2026 does not give the date of that roll.
data/hyderabad/parts.csv.deleted: Names in the part on the September 2026 list of absent, shifted and dead electors, struck off the draft roll, as a count.
data/hyderabad/parts.csv.rate: Names struck off per 100 electors in the part.
data/hyderabad/parts.csv.muslim_share_roll: The share of the part's electors whose names were guessed from names to be Muslim, as a percentage, since the roll records no religion.
data/hyderabad/parts.csv.muslim_rate: Names struck off per 100 electors whose names were guessed to be Muslim, left blank where the part has fewer than 20 such electors.
data/hyderabad/parts.csv.hindu_rate: Names struck off per 100 electors whose names were guessed to be Hindu, left blank where the part has fewer than 20 such electors.
data/hyderabad/parts.csv.untraceable_share_of_deleted: The share of the part's struck-off names entered as untraceable or absent, as a percentage, where the reason is what the officer wrote down, and nobody checked it.
data/hyderabad/parts.csv.hearing_rate: Electors in the part called to a hearing from the no-mapping list or the logical discrepancy list, per 100 electors on the roll before the revision.

data/india/ac_change.csv.state: The state, one of the four that published their rolls by constituency (Tamil Nadu, Kerala, West Bengal and Uttarakhand).
data/india/ac_change.csv.district: The district the constituency lies in.
data/india/ac_change.csv.earlier_roll: The earliest roll in the row, which is the roll of 27 October 2025 worked out as the draft plus the names left off for Tamil Nadu, the January 2025 final roll for Kerala, the 2024 Lok Sabha roll for West Bengal and blank for Uttarakhand.
data/india/ac_change.csv.left_off_draft: Names left off the draft, as a count, given by constituency only in Tamil Nadu.
data/india/ac_change.csv.draft: Electors on the draft roll (19 December 2025 in Tamil Nadu, 23 December 2025 in Kerala, 16 December 2025 in West Bengal, July 2026 in Uttarakhand).
data/india/ac_change.csv.added_after_draft: Claims admitted after the draft, as a count, Uttarakhand only, from the Chief Electoral Officer's PN 63/2026.
data/india/ac_change.csv.removed_after_draft: Objections admitted after the draft, as a count, Uttarakhand only, from PN 63/2026.
data/india/ac_change.csv.later_roll: The latest roll in the row, the final roll of 23 February 2026 in Tamil Nadu, 21 February 2026 in Kerala and 3 October 2026 in Uttarakhand, and the roll at the 2026 nominations in West Bengal.
data/india/ac_change.csv.change_draft_to_later: later_roll less draft, a net change that counts new voters added after the draft as well as names put back.
data/india/ac_change.csv.change_earlier_to_later: later_roll less earlier_roll, as a count, which is negative where the roll fell.

data/india/border.csv.measure: The count and its base, which is names left off per 100 on the roll before (Uttar Pradesh, Gujarat), names removed in both phases per 100 on the 2025 roll (Bihar), the fall in the roll per 100 from the 2024 roll to the draft (West Bengal) and names removed after the draft per 1,000 on the draft (Uttarakhand).
data/india/border.csv.part: Which districts the row covers, where border is every district on the Government of India's list of Border Guarding Districts, interior the rest, interior_without_city the rest without the city's districts, and border district names one listed district.
data/india/border.csv.districts: The number of districts in the row.
data/india/border.csv.base: Electors on the roll the measure divides by, summed over the districts, blank on single-district rows.
data/india/border.csv.count: The count the measure names, summed over the districts, blank on single-district rows.
data/india/border.csv.rate: count per 100 electors on base, or per 1,000 for Uttarakhand.
data/india/border.csv.dead_share: The share of the count entered as dead, as a percentage, where reasons were published (Uttar Pradesh and Gujarat), and the reason is what the officer wrote down, and nobody checked it.
data/india/border.csv.shifted_absent_share: The share of the count entered as shifted or absent, as a percentage, where reasons were published.
data/india/border.csv.enrolled_elsewhere_share: The share of the count entered as enrolled somewhere else, as a percentage, where reasons were published.

data/india/cities.csv.city: The city, drawn as the districts named in districts.
data/india/cities.csv.state: The state the row's districts are in, which for Delhi's ring is Uttar Pradesh.
data/india/cities.csv.measure: What is counted, where left_off means names left off the draft and fall means the fall in the roll from an earlier roll to the draft (West Bengal from the 2024 Lok Sabha roll, Kerala from the January 2025 roll), a change that takes in ordinary deaths and moves as well.
data/india/cities.csv.part: Which part of the city the row covers, where core is the city's own districts, ring the neighbouring districts and rest the rest of the state.
data/india/cities.csv.districts: The districts the row adds up, separated by a semicolon character, or rest of state.
data/india/cities.csv.base_roll: Electors on the roll the count is measured against, the roll named in base_roll_is.
data/india/cities.csv.base_roll_is: Which roll base_roll is. It is the roll before the revision everywhere except Patna (the 2025 election roll), Kolkata (the 2024 Lok Sabha roll) and Kochi (the January 2025 roll).
data/india/cities.csv.names_left_off_or_fall: Names left off the draft, or for Kolkata and Kochi the fall in the roll to the draft, as a count (Patna counts both of Bihar's phases).
data/india/cities.csv.state_per_100: The same rate for the city's whole state.
data/india/cities.csv.note: A note where the row's figures differ in kind, marking Hyderabad's figures as reported in the press and Patna's as per 100 on the 2025 roll.

data/india/final_rolls.csv.state: The state or union territory, listed where a final roll or its date has been found.
data/india/final_rolls.csv.phase: The phase of the revision the state was in, 1, 2 or 3.
data/india/final_rolls.csv.roll_before: Electors on the roll before the revision, as a count, from the state table.
data/india/final_rolls.csv.left_off_draft: Names left off the draft roll, as a count.
data/india/final_rolls.csv.final_date: The date the final roll was published, as YYYY-MM-DD.
data/india/final_rolls.csv.added_after_draft: Names added between the draft and the final roll, as a count, blank where the state published only the net change.
data/india/final_rolls.csv.removed_after_draft: Names removed between the draft and the final roll, as a count, blank where none was published.
data/india/final_rolls.csv.withheld: Names kept off the final roll while their cases were adjudicated, as a count (West Bengal only).
data/india/final_rolls.csv.final_roll: Electors on the final roll, as a count.
data/india/final_rolls.csv.final_less_draft: The final roll less the draft roll in the final-roll source, a net change that counts new voters added after the draft as well as names put back.
data/india/final_rolls.csv.net_fall: Names left off the draft less final_less_draft, which is the net fall in the roll from before the revision to the final roll, as a count.
data/india/final_rolls.csv.net_fall_per_100: The net fall per 100 electors on the roll before the revision.
data/india/final_rolls.csv.reconciles: Whether draft plus added less removed and withheld equals the final roll, where exact means to the elector, rounded means within rounding, net only means the state gave the net rise in place of the gross figures, and no means the published figures do not add up.
data/india/final_rolls.csv.source: The address of the document the final-roll figures come from.

data/india/lok_sabha_electors.csv.election: The Lok Sabha general election, by year (1984-85 includes Assam and Punjab, which polled in 1985).
data/india/lok_sabha_electors.csv.electors: Electors on the roll for that election across India, as a count, from the Election Commission's Atlas 2024, Graph 6.1.
data/india/lok_sabha_electors.csv.electors_crore: The same electors in crore (ten million), to two decimal places.
data/india/lok_sabha_electors.csv.voting_age: The voting age at that election, 21 for 1984-85 and 18 from 1989 after the 61st Amendment.
data/india/lok_sabha_electors.csv.pop_voting_age: India's population at or above the voting age on 1 July of the election year, as a count, from the UN World Population Prospects 2024, medium variant.
data/india/lok_sabha_electors.csv.pop_voting_age_crore: The same population of voting age in crore, to two decimal places.
data/india/lok_sabha_electors.csv.electors_per_100_of_voting_age: Electors per 100 people of voting age, which can pass 100 if the population estimate is right and the roll holds names of the dead or moved, and which counts residents who are not citizens in the population.
data/india/lok_sabha_electors.csv.note: A note on the row, such as the misprint corrected in the Atlas's 1991-92 figure.
data/india/lok_sabha_electors.csv.electors_source: The source of the electors figure, the Election Commission's Atlas 2024, Graph 6.1 (printed page 19).
data/india/lok_sabha_electors.csv.population_source: The source of the population figure, the UN World Population Prospects 2024, medium variant, single-year ages, 1 July of the election year.

data/india/margins_ls2024.csv.state: The state, one of the four with constituency figures (Bihar, Tamil Nadu, West Bengal and Kerala).
data/india/margins_ls2024.csv.pc: The Lok Sabha constituency number within the state.
data/india/margins_ls2024.csv.count: The count named in what_is_counted, summed over the seat's assembly segments, using the segment list of the Election Commission's statistical report 34.
data/india/margins_ls2024.csv.what_is_counted: What count is used, which is the names removed in both phases in Bihar, the names removed at the draft in Tamil Nadu, and the fall in the roll up to the 2026 election in West Bengal (from the 2024 roll) and Kerala (from the January 2025 roll), a change that takes in ordinary additions and deletions as well as the revision.
data/india/margins_ls2024.csv.margin_2024: The seat's winning margin in votes at the 2024 Lok Sabha election.
data/india/margins_ls2024.csv.winner_party_2024: The party that won the seat in 2024, as the results print it.
data/india/margins_ls2024.csv.runner_up_party_2024: The party that came second in 2024, as the results print it.
data/india/margins_ls2024.csv.count_exceeds_margin: Whether count is larger than margin_2024, yes or no, which says the count was large enough to decide the seat and says nothing about whether it did.
data/india/margins_ls2024.csv.source: The source of the 2024 results and segments, the Election Commission's results and statistical report 34 through a published compilation of them.

data/india/notices.csv.phase: The phase of the revision the state was in, 1, 2 or 3.
data/india/notices.csv.draft: Electors on the draft roll, worked out as the roll before the revision less the names left off, as a count.
data/india/notices.csv.notices: Electors kept on the draft roll but sent a notice to prove their entry, as a count, from the figure chosen by the rules in scripts/build_notices.py.
data/india/notices.csv.how: How the notices total was got, where published means a total the source printed and sum means the two lists added because the source gave no total.
data/india/notices.csv.per_100: Notices per 100 electors on the draft roll.
data/india/notices.csv.kind: Whether the notices figure is primary (a document of the Election Commission or a Chief Electoral Officer) or press (a newspaper or broadcaster).
data/india/notices.csv.rounded: Whether the notices figure was printed rounded, True or False.
data/india/notices.csv.date: The date of the source for the notices figure, as YYYY-MM-DD, and many later figures are running counts taken while notices were still being heard.
data/india/notices.csv.no_mapping: Electors sent a notice because they could not be linked to the roll of the last intensive revision, as a count, where published.
data/india/notices.csv.discrepancy: Electors sent a notice from the Commission's logical discrepancy list of mismatched names, ages and family links, as a count, where published, and an elector can be on both lists.
data/india/notices.csv.deleted_after_notice: Names deleted after a notice, as a count, the latest figure found.
data/india/notices.csv.source_url: The address of the source of the notices figure.
data/india/notices.csv.lists_source: The address of the source of the two list figures.

data/india/process_schedules.csv.state: The state or union territory the schedule is for.
data/india/process_schedules.csv.phase: The phase of the revision the state was in, written I, II or III.
data/india/process_schedules.csv.schedule: The order, letter or release the dates come from, or a label saying the dates are those the state actually published.
data/india/process_schedules.csv.as_published: Whether the dates are those the state actually kept as published (yes) or dates that were set in advance (no).
data/india/process_schedules.csv.enumeration_from: The first day of enumeration, the house-to-house round of forms, as YYYY-MM-DD.
data/india/process_schedules.csv.enumeration_to: The last day of enumeration, as YYYY-MM-DD.
data/india/process_schedules.csv.draft_roll: The date of the draft roll, as YYYY-MM-DD.
data/india/process_schedules.csv.claims_from: The first day for claims and objections against the draft, as YYYY-MM-DD.
data/india/process_schedules.csv.claims_to: The last day for claims and objections, as YYYY-MM-DD.
data/india/process_schedules.csv.notices_from: The first day of the period for notices and hearings, as YYYY-MM-DD.
data/india/process_schedules.csv.notices_to: The last day of the period for notices and hearings, as YYYY-MM-DD.
data/india/process_schedules.csv.final_roll: The date of the final roll, as YYYY-MM-DD.
data/india/process_schedules.csv.document_link: The address of the document the dates come from.

data/india/process_timeline.csv.date: The date of the order, letter, judgment or release, as YYYY-MM-DD.
data/india/process_timeline.csv.who: Who issued it, the Election Commission, the Supreme Court or a state election officer.
data/india/process_timeline.csv.phase: Which part of the revision the entry concerns (Bihar, Phase II, Phase III, West Bengal or Assam).
data/india/process_timeline.csv.title: A short title for the change.
data/india/process_timeline.csv.what_changed: A plain account of what the document changed in the rules or dates of the revision.
data/india/process_timeline.csv.documents: The names of the documents the entry rests on, separated by a vertical bar.
data/india/process_timeline.csv.document_links: The addresses of those documents, in the same order, separated by a vertical bar.

data/india/reserved.csv.measure: The count and its base, which is names removed in both phases per 100 on the 2025 roll for Bihar, names left off per 100 on the roll before for Tamil Nadu, Gujarat and Delhi, and the fall in the roll to the draft per 100 for West Bengal (from the 2024 roll) and Kerala (from the January 2025 roll).
data/india/reserved.csv.category: The kind of seat under the Delimitation Order of 2008, GEN for general, SC for Scheduled Castes and ST for Scheduled Tribes.
data/india/reserved.csv.seats: The number of assembly seats in that category.
data/india/reserved.csv.rate: The count per 100 electors across all seats in the category, in the measure named.
data/india/reserved.csv.mean_gap_vs_general_seats_same_district: The average, over the reserved seats, of each seat's rate less the rate of the general seats in its own district, in points per 100, blank for general seats.
data/india/reserved.csv.seats_above_their_district: How many reserved seats have a higher rate than the general seats of their own district.
data/india/reserved.csv.seats_compared: How many reserved seats had general seats in their district to be compared with.

data/india/states.csv.state: The state or union territory, one row for each of the 32 in the revision.
data/india/states.csv.phase: The phase of the revision the state was in, where 1 is Bihar (order of 24 June 2025), 2 the states of the order of 27 October 2025 and 3 the states of the order of 14 May 2026.
data/india/states.csv.draft_date: The date the state's draft roll was published, as YYYY-MM-DD.
data/india/states.csv.electors_before: Electors on the roll before the revision as the Chief Electoral Officer gave it at the draft, as a count.
data/india/states.csv.removed: Names left off the draft roll, as a count, from the Chief Electoral Officer's figures (Bihar's from the phase 1 deletion lists).
data/india/states.csv.per_100: Names left off the draft per 100 electors on the roll before the revision.
data/india/states.csv.dead: Names left off the draft that were entered as dead, as a count, where the reason is what the officer wrote down, and nobody checked it.
data/india/states.csv.shifted_absent_other: Names left off the draft that were entered as shifted, absent or untraceable, or under any other reason the state reported, as a count.
data/india/states.csv.duplicate: Names left off the draft that were entered as enrolled more than once, as a count.
data/india/states.csv.unsplit: Names left off the draft that the published reasons do not account for, as a count, which is every name left off where no split by reason was published.
data/india/states.csv.split: How far the reasons were published, where complete means the three add up to the names left off within rounding, short means they fall short of it, none means no split was published and pending means there is no draft yet.
data/india/states.csv.figures: Whether the state's figures are exact counts or were printed rounded, in lakh or crore.
data/india/states.csv.source: Where the figures come from, where primary is a document of the Election Commission or a Chief Electoral Officer, press is a newspaper or broadcaster and lists is Bihar's own deletion lists.
data/india/states.csv.source_url: The address of the document the figures come from.
data/india/states.csv.final_date: The date the final roll was published, as YYYY-MM-DD, blank where none has been found.
data/india/states.csv.added_after_draft: Names added between the draft and the final roll, as a count, blank where the state published only the net change.
data/india/states.csv.removed_after_draft: Names removed between the draft and the final roll, as a count.
data/india/states.csv.withheld: Names kept off the final roll while their cases were adjudicated, as a count, which only West Bengal reported.
data/india/states.csv.electors_final: Electors on the final roll, as a count.
data/india/states.csv.net_after_draft: The final roll less the draft roll, a net change that counts new voters added after the draft as well as names put back.
data/india/states.csv.net_fall: Names left off the draft less net_after_draft, which is the net fall in the roll from before the revision to the final roll, as a count.
data/india/states.csv.net_fall_per_100: The net fall per 100 electors on the roll before the revision.
data/india/states.csv.made_up_pct: net_after_draft as a percentage of the names left off the draft, an upper bound on the share put back because the rise counts new voters too.
data/india/states.csv.note: A plain note on how the state's draft figures were read or combined.
data/india/states.csv.roll_adult_pct: Electors on the roll before the revision per 100 people aged 18 and over projected for 1 March 2026 by the Technical Group on Population Projections.
data/india/states.csv.draft_adult_pct: Electors on the draft roll per 100 people aged 18 and over projected for 1 March 2026.
data/india/states.csv.removed_pct_votes24: Names left off the draft as a percentage of the votes polled in the state at the 2024 Lok Sabha election.
data/india/states.csv.women_share_removed: Women as a percentage of the names left off the draft, where the state's split by sex is known.
data/india/states.csv.women_share_roll: Women as a percentage of the roll before the revision, where known.
data/india/states.csv.sex_split_quality: How firm the split by sex is, where lists means counted from Bihar's lists, exact and rounded mean an official figure printed in full or rounded, proxy means the roll before is a stand-in roll and unverified means a press figure with no primary source.
data/india/states.csv.income_pc: Net state domestic product per head at current prices for 2023-24, in rupees, from the Reserve Bank's handbook of state statistics (MoSPI for Gujarat).
data/india/states.csv.mpce_rural: Average monthly spending per person in rural areas in 2023-24, in rupees, from the Household Consumption Expenditure Survey without the value of free items.
data/india/states.csv.mpce_urban: Average monthly spending per person in urban areas in 2023-24, in rupees, from the Household Consumption Expenditure Survey without the value of free items.
data/india/states.csv.urban_pct: The urban share of the population projected for 1 March 2026 by the Technical Group, as a percentage.
data/india/states.csv.literacy: The literacy rate of people aged 7 and over, as a percentage, from the Periodic Labour Force Survey 2023-24.
data/india/states.csv.female_literacy: The literacy rate of women and girls aged 7 and over, as a percentage, from the Periodic Labour Force Survey 2023-24.
data/india/states.csv.muslim_pct: The share of households whose head is Muslim, as a percentage, from the National Family Health Survey 2019-21.
data/india/states.csv.sc_pct: The share of households whose head is from a Scheduled Caste, as a percentage, from the National Family Health Survey 2019-21.
data/india/states.csv.st_pct: The share of households whose head is from a Scheduled Tribe, as a percentage, from the National Family Health Survey 2019-21.
data/india/states.csv.sex_ratio: Females per 1,000 males in the whole population, from the National Family Health Survey 2019-21.
data/india/states.csv.out_migration: People born in the state and counted in another Indian state at the 2011 census, as a percentage of the state's own population counted in 2011, from Census table D-01 (place of birth). For Bihar that is 79,49,853 over 10,40,99,452, or 7.64.
data/india/states.csv.in_migration: People counted in the state at the 2011 census who were born in another Indian state, as a percentage of the state's own population counted in 2011, from Census table D-01 (place of birth). People born outside India are not counted. For Bihar that is 10,66,526 over 10,40,99,452, or 1.02.
data/india/states.csv.intl_border: Whether the state has an international land border, yes or no, from the Ministry of Home Affairs.

data/india/urban.csv.measure: What is counted, where left_off means names left off the draft per 100 on the roll before, roll_2025 means Bihar's names removed in both phases per 100 on the 2025 roll, and fall means the fall in the roll to the draft (West Bengal from the 2024 roll, Kerala from the January 2025 roll).
data/india/urban.csv.district_2011: The district as it stood at the 2011 census, which is the unit each row adds up.
data/india/urban.csv.census_code: The 2011 census code of that district.
data/india/urban.csv.districts_today: The present districts counted under it, each under the 2011 district it was mostly made from, separated by a semicolon character.
data/india/urban.csv.urban_pct_2011: The share of the 2011 district's people living in towns at the 2011 census, as a percentage, from table A-01.
data/india/urban.csv.band: rural where urban_pct_2011 is under 20, mixed from 20 to 50, and urban above 50.
data/india/urban.csv.roll_before: Electors on the roll the count is measured against, summed over the districts, as a count.
data/india/urban.csv.count: Names left off, or the fall in the roll, summed over the districts, as a count.

data/india/factors.csv.measure: What is counted, where left_off means names left off the draft per 100 on the roll before, roll_2025 means Bihar's names removed in both phases per 100 on the 2025 roll, and fall means the fall in the roll to the draft (West Bengal from the 2024 roll, Kerala from the January 2025 roll), change_2023 means Rajasthan's fall in the roll from the 2023 election roll to the final roll of 2026 per 100, and after_draft means Uttarakhand's names removed after the draft per 100 on the draft.
data/india/factors.csv.nfhs5_district: The district as the National Family Health Survey 2019-21 published it, which is the unit each row adds up. Delhi's are the 11 districts of its 2025 roll.
data/india/factors.csv.districts_today: The present districts counted under it, separated by a semicolon character. A district made after the survey is counted under the one it was made from.
data/india/factors.csv.roll_before: Electors on the roll the count is measured against, summed over the districts, as a count.
data/india/factors.csv.count: Names left off, or the fall in the roll, summed over the districts, as a count.
data/india/factors.csv.women_literate: Women aged 15 to 49 who can read, as a percentage, NFHS-5 district fact sheet indicator 14.
data/india/factors.csv.women_10yr: Women aged 15 to 49 with ten or more years of schooling, as a percentage, NFHS-5 indicator 15.
data/india/factors.csv.married_18: Women aged 20 to 24 married before age 18, as a percentage, NFHS-5 indicator 16.
data/india/factors.csv.clean_fuel: Households using clean fuel for cooking, as a percentage, NFHS-5 indicator 10.
data/india/factors.csv.sanitation: Population living in households that use an improved sanitation facility, as a percentage, NFHS-5 indicator 9.
data/india/factors.csv.death_reg: Deaths in the three years before the survey that were registered with the civil authority, as a percentage, NFHS-5 indicator 6.
data/india/factors.csv.sex_ratio: Females per 1,000 males in the whole population, NFHS-5 indicator 3.

data/india/women.csv.level: Whether the row is a whole state or one district.
data/india/women.csv.district: The district, blank on state rows.
data/india/women.csv.measure: The count the row's shares are of. For district rows it names the state's own measure, such as the names removed in both phases in Bihar or the fall from the 2024 roll to the 2026 election roll in West Bengal.
data/india/women.csv.women_share_of_roll: Women as a percentage of the roll the count is taken from (the roll before for states, Bihar's draft plus phase 1 removals, the 2024 and January 2025 rolls for West Bengal and Kerala, and the draft for Uttarakhand).
data/india/women.csv.women_share_of_count: Women as a percentage of the count named in measure.
data/india/women.csv.gap_points: women_share_of_count less women_share_of_roll, in percentage points.
data/india/women.csv.women_left_off_per_100_women: Women left off the draft per 100 women on the roll before, where the roll by sex is the roll before times women's share of it, on state rows only.
data/india/women.csv.men_left_off_per_100_men: Men left off the draft per 100 men on the roll before, on state rows only.
data/india/women.csv.quality: How firm the state's split by sex is (lists, exact, rounded, proxy or unverified), on state rows only.
data/india/women.csv.source_url: The address of the source of the state's split by sex, on state rows only.

data/india/women_removed.csv.state: The state or union territory, listed where the names left off the draft have been found split by sex.
data/india/women_removed.csv.phase: The phase of the revision the state was in, 1, 2 or 3.
data/india/women_removed.csv.women_removed: Women among the names left off the draft, as a count (Bihar's counted from the phase 1 deletion lists).
data/india/women_removed.csv.men_removed: Men among the names left off the draft, as a count.
data/india/women_removed.csv.women_pct_of_removed: Women as a percentage of the women and men left off the draft.
data/india/women_removed.csv.women_pct_of_roll: Women as a percentage of the roll before the revision.
data/india/women_removed.csv.gap_points: women_pct_of_removed less women_pct_of_roll, in percentage points.
data/india/women_removed.csv.quality: How firm the split by sex is, where lists means counted from Bihar's lists, exact and rounded mean an official figure printed in full or rounded, proxy means the roll before is a stand-in roll and unverified means a press figure with no primary source.
data/india/women_removed.csv.note: A plain note on where the split by sex comes from and how it was read.
data/india/women_removed.csv.source: The address of the source of the split by sex, blank for Bihar, whose figures come from the lists on this site.

data/jharkhand/tables.csv.table: Which part of the file the row belongs to, where state marks one of Jharkhand's headline figures and every row in this file is one, because no table below the state was published.
data/jharkhand/tables.csv.level: The level of the row, state for a headline figure, which is every row in this file.
data/jharkhand/tables.csv.name: Which headline figure the value is (roll_before means the roll before the revision, draft means the draft roll, removed means the names left off the draft, dead means names left off entered as dead, shifted_absent_other means names left off entered as shifted, absent or other, duplicate means names left off entered as enrolled more than once, third_draft means third-gender electors on the draft, notices means electors kept on the draft but sent a notice).
data/jharkhand/tables.csv.value: The headline figure named in name, as a count of electors, where the draft roll was published on 5 August 2026, and blank on table rows.
data/jharkhand/tables.csv.before: On table rows, electors on the roll before the revision, or on the earlier roll a fall table names, in an area, as a count, and it is blank in every row of this file.
data/jharkhand/tables.csv.draft: On table rows, electors on the draft roll in an area, as a count, and it is blank in every row of this file.
data/jharkhand/tables.csv.removed: On table rows, names left off the draft in an area, or names removed after the draft in an after table, as a count, and it is blank in every row of this file.
data/jharkhand/tables.csv.added: On table rows, names added after the draft in an area, as a count, and it is blank in every row of this file.
data/jharkhand/tables.csv.net: On table rows, the net change after the draft in an area, which counts new voters as well as names put back, as a count, and it is blank in every row of this file.
data/jharkhand/tables.csv.final: On table rows, electors on the final roll in an area, as a count, and it is blank in every row of this file.
data/jharkhand/tables.csv.men: Men on the roll a table row is split by sex, as a count, and it is blank in every row of this file.
data/jharkhand/tables.csv.women: Women on the roll a table row is split by sex, as a count, and it is blank in every row of this file.
data/jharkhand/tables.csv.third: Third-gender electors on the roll a table row is split by sex, as a count, and it is blank in every row of this file.
data/jharkhand/tables.csv.dead: On left-off table rows, names left off entered as dead, as a count, where the reason is what the officer wrote down, and nobody checked it, and it is blank in every row of this file.
data/jharkhand/tables.csv.shifted_absent_other: On left-off table rows, names left off entered as shifted, absent or under any other reason, as a count, and it is blank in every row of this file.
data/jharkhand/tables.csv.duplicate: On left-off table rows, names left off entered as enrolled more than once, as a count, and it is blank in every row of this file.
data/jharkhand/tables.csv.source: The title of the document the figure or table comes from.
data/jharkhand/tables.csv.press: yes where the figure or table reached the site through a newspaper or broadcaster, and no where it was read in an official document.
data/jharkhand/tables.csv.partial: On table rows, yes where the table covers only some areas and is checked row by row, and no where it is complete and adds up to the state figure, and blank on state rows, and it is blank in every row of this file.

data/karnataka/districts.csv.district: The election district, one of the 34 the Chief Electoral Officer published by, where Bengaluru is Bangalore Urban and the three B.B.M.P districts.
data/karnataka/districts.csv.roll_before: Electors on the roll of 16 June 2026, before the revision, from the Chief Electoral Officer's press note of 24 August 2026.
data/karnataka/districts.csv.removed: Names left off the draft roll of 24 August 2026, as a count.
data/karnataka/districts.csv.removed_per_100: Names left off per 100 electors on the roll before the revision.
data/karnataka/districts.csv.absent: Names left off entered as absent, as a count, where the reason is what the officer wrote down, and nobody checked it.
data/karnataka/districts.csv.shifted: Names left off entered as permanently shifted, as a count.
data/karnataka/districts.csv.dead: Names left off entered as dead, as a count.
data/karnataka/districts.csv.already_enrolled: Names left off entered as already enrolled somewhere else, as a count.
data/karnataka/districts.csv.other: Names left off entered under any other reason, as a count.
data/karnataka/districts.csv.draft_roll: Electors on the draft roll of 24 August 2026.
data/karnataka/districts.csv.roll_9_oct_2026: Electors on the roll of 9 October 2026, published while notices were being heard. The final roll is due on 27 October 2026.
data/karnataka/districts.csv.net_fall_per_100: The fall from the roll before the revision to the roll of 25 September 2026, per 100 electors on the roll before, where the rise after the draft counts new voters too.

data/kerala/constituencies.csv.ac: The assembly constituency number in Kerala, from 1 to 140.
data/kerala/constituencies.csv.name: The constituency's name as the draft roll prints it.
data/kerala/constituencies.csv.district: The district the constituency lies in.
data/kerala/constituencies.csv.roll_jan_2025: Electors on the final roll of the January 2025 summary revision (6 January 2025).
data/kerala/constituencies.csv.draft_roll_dec_2025: Electors on the draft roll of 23 December 2025.
data/kerala/constituencies.csv.final_roll_feb_2026: Electors on the final roll of 21 February 2026.
data/kerala/constituencies.csv.roll_mar_2026: Electors on the roll of 23 March 2026, the roll the 2026 election was held on.
data/kerala/constituencies.csv.fall_to_draft: roll_jan_2025 less the draft roll, a change in the roll that takes in the ordinary changes of 2025 as well as the revision.
data/kerala/constituencies.csv.fall_to_draft_per_100: fall_to_draft per 100 electors on the January 2025 roll.
data/kerala/constituencies.csv.fall_to_election_roll: roll_jan_2025 less roll_mar_2026, negative where the roll grew, and the rise after the draft counts new voters too.
data/kerala/constituencies.csv.fall_to_election_roll_per_100: fall_to_election_roll per 100 electors on the January 2025 roll.
data/kerala/constituencies.csv.women_pct_2025: Women as a percentage of the January 2025 roll.
data/kerala/constituencies.csv.women_pct_of_fall_to_draft: Women as a percentage of fall_to_draft, worked out as the fall in women on the roll over the fall in the whole roll.
data/kerala/constituencies.csv.winner_2026: The party that won the seat at the 2026 Kerala assembly election, from the Election Commission's results.
data/kerala/constituencies.csv.runner_up_2026: The party that came second in 2026.
data/kerala/constituencies.csv.margin_2026: The 2026 winning margin in votes, the winner's votes less the runner-up's.
data/kerala/constituencies.csv.votes_2026: Total votes polled in the constituency in 2026.
data/kerala/constituencies.csv.turnout_2026: votes_2026 as a percentage of the roll of 23 March 2026.
data/kerala/constituencies.csv.fall_over_margin: Whether fall_to_election_roll is larger than the 2026 margin, True or False, which says it could have decided the seat and says nothing about whether it did.
data/kerala/constituencies.csv.fall_at_turnout_over_margin: Whether fall_to_election_roll, where positive, times the seat's 2026 turnout is larger than the 2026 margin, True or False.

data/kerala/districts.csv.acs: The number of assembly constituencies in the district.
data/kerala/districts.csv.roll_jan_2025: Electors on the final roll of the January 2025 summary revision, summed over the district's constituencies.
data/kerala/districts.csv.draft_roll_dec_2025: Electors on the draft roll of 23 December 2025.
data/kerala/districts.csv.final_roll_feb_2026: Electors on the final roll of 21 February 2026.
data/kerala/districts.csv.roll_mar_2026: Electors on the roll of 23 March 2026, the roll the 2026 election was held on.
data/kerala/districts.csv.fall_to_draft_per_100: The fall from the January 2025 roll to the draft per 100 electors on the January 2025 roll, a change in the roll that takes in the ordinary changes of 2025 as well as the revision.

data/westbengal/constituencies.csv.ac: The assembly constituency number in West Bengal, from 1 to 294.
data/westbengal/constituencies.csv.name: The constituency's name as the draft roll table prints it.
data/westbengal/constituencies.csv.district: The district the constituency lies in, one of 24.
data/westbengal/constituencies.csv.roll_2024_ls: Electors on the roll at the 2024 Lok Sabha nominations.
data/westbengal/constituencies.csv.draft_roll_2025: Electors on the draft roll of 16 December 2025.
data/westbengal/constituencies.csv.roll_2026_election: Electors on the roll at the 2026 assembly nominations, the roll the 2026 election was held on.
data/westbengal/constituencies.csv.fall_to_draft: roll_2024_ls less the draft roll, a change over eighteen months that takes in ordinary additions and deletions as well as the revision.
data/westbengal/constituencies.csv.fall_to_election_roll: roll_2024_ls less roll_2026_election, negative where the roll grew.
data/westbengal/constituencies.csv.fall_per_100: fall_to_election_roll per 100 electors on the 2024 roll.
data/westbengal/constituencies.csv.women_pct_2024: Women as a percentage of the 2024 roll.
data/westbengal/constituencies.csv.women_pct_2026: Women as a percentage of the 2026 election roll.
data/westbengal/constituencies.csv.winner_2026: The party that won the seat at the 2026 West Bengal assembly election.
data/westbengal/constituencies.csv.runner_up_2026: The party that came second in 2026.
data/westbengal/constituencies.csv.margin_2026: The 2026 winning margin in votes, the winner's votes less the runner-up's.
data/westbengal/constituencies.csv.votes_2026: Total votes polled in the constituency in 2026.
data/westbengal/constituencies.csv.turnout_2026: votes_2026 as a percentage of roll_2026_election.
data/westbengal/constituencies.csv.fall_over_margin: Whether fall_to_election_roll is larger than the 2026 margin, True or False, which says it could have decided the seat and says nothing about whether it did.
data/westbengal/constituencies.csv.fall_at_turnout_over_margin: Whether fall_to_election_roll, where positive, times the seat's 2026 turnout is larger than the 2026 margin, True or False.

data/westbengal/districts.csv.acs: The number of assembly constituencies in the district.
data/westbengal/districts.csv.roll_2024_ls: Electors on the roll at the 2024 Lok Sabha nominations, summed over the district's constituencies.
data/westbengal/districts.csv.draft_roll_2025: Electors on the draft roll of 16 December 2025.
data/westbengal/districts.csv.roll_2026_election: Electors on the roll at the 2026 assembly nominations.
data/westbengal/districts.csv.fall_to_draft_per_100: The fall from the 2024 roll to the draft per 100 electors on the 2024 roll, a change over eighteen months that takes in ordinary additions and deletions as well as the revision.
data/westbengal/districts.csv.fall_to_election_roll_per_100: The fall from the 2024 roll to the 2026 election roll per 100 electors on the 2024 roll.
data/westbengal/districts.csv.women_pct_2024: Women as a percentage of the 2024 roll.
data/westbengal/districts.csv.women_pct_of_fall: Women as a percentage of the fall from the 2024 roll to the 2026 election roll.

data/india/disputes.csv.section: The section of the disputes page the item sits in, such as the courts, Form 7 objections or changes to the software.
data/india/disputes.csv.date: The date of the order, resolution or report, as the source gives it.
data/india/disputes.csv.state: The state or union territory the item concerns, or India for the revision as a whole.
data/india/disputes.csv.places: Constituencies, districts or cities the item names, separated by semicolons. Blank where it names none.
data/india/disputes.csv.court: The court, magistrate or tribunal, where the item is a case or an order. Blank otherwise.
data/india/disputes.csv.parties_and_bodies: The parties, officials' offices and organisations that act in the item, separated by semicolons. No private person is named.
data/india/disputes.csv.issues: One to three issues the item concerns, from a fixed list, separated by semicolons.
data/india/disputes.csv.kind: Document when the item quotes the court, the Assembly or the Commission itself, report when it quotes a named press report.
data/india/disputes.csv.source: The court, body or outlet the item comes from.
data/india/disputes.csv.what_happened: One sentence saying what the source records or reports, attributed to it.
data/india/disputes.csv.commission_reply: The Commission's or the official's reply as the same source reported it, where there was one.

data/maharashtra/top38.csv.constituency: Constituency name, as the CEO's table prints it.
data/maharashtra/top38.csv.district: District, as the CEO's table prints it.
data/maharashtra/top38.csv.total_electors: Total electors, as the CEO's table prints them.
data/maharashtra/top38.csv.forms_not_collected: Enumeration forms not collected, the names left off the draft.
data/maharashtra/top38.csv.not_collected_pct: Forms not collected per 100 total electors, as printed.

data/india/rti.csv.state: The state the application concerns, or All India for one about the revision as a whole.
data/india/rti.csv.authority: The public authority the application went to, such as the Election Commission or a state's Chief Electoral Officer.
data/india/rti.csv.applicant: The organisation that filed it, or the applicant's role. No private person is named.
data/india/rti.csv.filed: The date the application was filed, where it was reported.
data/india/rti.csv.replied: The date of the reply, where it was reported.
data/india/rti.csv.days: Days from the application to the reply, where both dates were reported. The Act allows 30.
data/india/rti.csv.outcome: What became of it: no record held, refused, transferred, partly supplied, supplied, appeal, no reply in time or pending.
data/india/rti.csv.answer: What the authority said or did, as reported.
data/india/rti.csv.rti_section: The section of the Act cited for a refusal, if any.
data/india/rti.csv.kind: primary if the reply itself was read, press if the item rests on a report.
data/india/rti.csv.source: The outlet that published the reply or reported it.

data/assam/constituencies.csv.final: Electors on the final roll of 10 February 2026.

data/assam/raw/ac_rolls.csv.total_final: All electors on the final roll of 10 February 2026.

data/uttarpradesh/seats.csv.ac_name: The constituency's name, as the Election Commission's 2022 statistical report spells it.
data/uttarpradesh/seats.csv.district: The district the constituency lies in, as the 2022 results list it.
data/uttarpradesh/seats.csv.electors_2022: Electors in the constituency at the 2022 Assembly election.

data/uttarpradesh/seats.csv.left_off_spread_by_electors: The district's names left off times the constituency's share of the district's 2022 electors. An estimate, not a count.

data/uttarakhand/raw/ac_draft_asdd.csv.level: ac for a constituency, district for a district total, state for the grand total, as the table prints them.
data/uttarakhand/raw/ac_draft_asdd.csv.draft: Electors on the draft roll of 14.07.2026.
data/uttarakhand/raw/ac_draft_asdd.csv.anomalies: Electors with Anomalies: entries on the draft with at least one of the eight anomalies below. One elector can carry several.
data/uttarakhand/raw/ac_draft_asdd.csv.anomalies_pct: Electors with anomalies as a percentage of the draft, as printed.
data/uttarakhand/raw/ac_draft_asdd.csv.no_mapping: No Mapping: electors on the draft whose entry could not be linked to the 2003 roll. Added to the anomalies, these are the 24,30,608 notices.
data/uttarakhand/raw/ac_draft_asdd.csv.no_mapping_pct: No mapping as a percentage of the anomalies, as printed.
data/uttarakhand/raw/ac_draft_asdd.csv.asdd_deleted: Electors Marked as ASDD during SIR (Deleted): marked absent, shifted, dead or duplicate and left off the draft. They add to the 8,26,977 of PN 36/2026.
data/uttarakhand/raw/ac_draft_asdd.csv.service_electors: Service electors on the draft of 14.07.2026.
data/uttarakhand/raw/ac_draft_asdd.csv.agegap_lt15: Electors on the draft whose entry showed an age gap of under 15 years with a parent. The categories overlap and are never added.
data/uttarakhand/raw/ac_draft_asdd.csv.agegap_lt15_pct: agegap_lt15 as a percentage of the electors with anomalies, as printed.
data/uttarakhand/raw/ac_draft_asdd.csv.agegap_gt50: Electors on the draft whose entry showed an age gap of over 50 years with a parent. The categories overlap and are never added.
data/uttarakhand/raw/ac_draft_asdd.csv.agegap_gt50_pct: agegap_gt50 as a percentage of the electors with anomalies, as printed.
data/uttarakhand/raw/ac_draft_asdd.csv.grandparent_lt40: Electors on the draft whose entry showed an age gap of under 40 years with a grandparent. The categories overlap and are never added.
data/uttarakhand/raw/ac_draft_asdd.csv.grandparent_lt40_pct: grandparent_lt40 as a percentage of the electors with anomalies, as printed.
data/uttarakhand/raw/ac_draft_asdd.csv.progeny_gt6: Electors on the draft whose entry showed more than six children linked to the same parent. The categories overlap and are never added.
data/uttarakhand/raw/ac_draft_asdd.csv.progeny_gt6_pct: progeny_gt6 as a percentage of the electors with anomalies, as printed.
data/uttarakhand/raw/ac_draft_asdd.csv.progeny_agediff_lt9m: Electors on the draft whose entry showed siblings born less than nine months apart. The categories overlap and are never added.
data/uttarakhand/raw/ac_draft_asdd.csv.progeny_agediff_lt9m_pct: progeny_agediff_lt9m as a percentage of the electors with anomalies, as printed.
data/uttarakhand/raw/ac_draft_asdd.csv.rel_name_var_progeny: Electors on the draft whose entry showed a relative's name spelt differently, where the entry was linked through a parent. The categories overlap and are never added.
data/uttarakhand/raw/ac_draft_asdd.csv.rel_name_var_progeny_pct: rel_name_var_progeny as a percentage of the electors with anomalies, as printed.
data/uttarakhand/raw/ac_draft_asdd.csv.self_name_var: Electors on the draft whose entry showed the elector's own name spelt differently from the 2003 roll. The categories overlap and are never added.
data/uttarakhand/raw/ac_draft_asdd.csv.self_name_var_pct: self_name_var as a percentage of the electors with anomalies, as printed.
data/uttarakhand/raw/ac_draft_asdd.csv.rel_name_var_self: Electors on the draft whose entry showed a relative's name spelt differently, where the entry was linked to the elector's own 2003 entry. The categories overlap and are never added.
data/uttarakhand/raw/ac_draft_asdd.csv.rel_name_var_self_pct: rel_name_var_self as a percentage of the electors with anomalies, as printed.
data/uttarakhand/raw/ac_draft_asdd.csv.ac: Assembly constituency number, blank on district and state rows.
data/uttarakhand/raw/ac_draft_asdd.csv.name: Constituency or district name as the table prints it.
data/uttarakhand/raw/ac_draft_asdd.csv.district: District, as the table prints it (U.S.Nagar for Udham Singh Nagar).

data/maharashtra/constituencies.csv.ac: The assembly constituency number in Maharashtra, from 1 to 288.
data/maharashtra/constituencies.csv.constituency: The constituency's name as the Chief Electoral Officer's tables print it, with Vikramgad spelt as the Commission does.

data/maharashtra/constituencies.csv.roll_before: Electors on the roll before the revision, from the CEO's statement of 16 September 2026.
data/maharashtra/constituencies.csv.draft_roll_31_aug_2026: Electors on the draft roll of 31 August 2026.

data/maharashtra/constituencies.csv.left_off_per_100: Names left off per 100 on the roll before the revision.

data/maharashtra/constituencies.csv.absent: Names left off entered as untraceable or absent.
data/maharashtra/constituencies.csv.enrolled_elsewhere: Names left off entered as already enrolled at another place.
data/maharashtra/constituencies.csv.other: Names left off entered under another reason.
data/maharashtra/constituencies.csv.women_pct_of_draft: Women as a share of the draft roll.
